exposure: implementation of a hospital guideline for rational prophylactic antibiotic use in elective cesarean sections (ECS)
withdrawal of metronidazole dosage forms from prophylactic antibiotics for ECS
outcome: compliance with international guidelines regarding prophylactic antibiotic use in ECS
cohort: The study included 195 participants undergoing elective cesarean sections at Elqutainah Teaching Hospital.
finding: The intervention, which involved implementing updated guidelines and withdrawing metronidazole, effectively minimized antibiotic overuse, reduced staff workload, and decreased medication costs for elective cesarean sections.
